<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peak series (spacing ~1.003 Da, intensities decreasing from 100 % to ~8 % for M+1, ~0.5 % for M+2, etc.), the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution of carbon atoms. No 2 Da spaced patterns (e.g., Cl, Br) or other distinctive isotope signatures are present, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
